name: Naselja Hrvatske (OSM, djelomični skup)
title: Naselja Hrvatske (OSM, djelomični skup)
description: OSM-derived list of 764 naselja (settlements) in Croatia at admin_level=8. Note: Croatia officially has ~6,800 naselja (DZS register); this dataset contains only those that have administrative-boundary relations in OSM, so coverage is partial — historically biased towards larger settlements and those within urban gradovi. Each record carries the OSM relation id, native and local names, parent-relation chain (encoding city → županija → država), centroid lat/lon and bounding box.
